text:
I had the opportunity to have dental work done at Thana Dental Clinic for the first time, thanks to a recommendation. I must say, I was very impressed. From the moment I stepped into the clinic, the atmosphere was clean and organized, and the staff were polite and courteous. I didn't feel pressured at all.
The dentist provided excellent care, explaining the treatment process in detail and outlining every step beforehand, which made me feel comfortable and relaxed. During the procedure, the dentist was very gentle. I'm usually a little afraid of dental work, but this time I felt much more relaxed than I expected. There was hardly any pain or flinching.
What I really appreciated was that the dentist didn't rush the procedure but worked slowly and carefully, providing clear and easy-to-understand instructions on post-treatment dental care. It wasn't just about treating and being done with it; it showed genuine concern for the patient's long-term dental health.
Another thing that impressed me was the very reasonable price. Compared to the quality of treatment and service, it was excellent value. I didn't feel overcharged or have any unrealistic recommendations, which made me feel comfortable and trusting.
Overall, it was a very good dental experience for me. If you're looking for a clinic with a gentle, kind dentist who explains things in detail, reasonable prices, and genuine patient care, I highly recommend this place. I will definitely be back for more services in the future. 😊
